method: Reviewed the current OpenAI rate limits and Anthropic API rate limits/errors pages for Retry-After behavior and retry boundaries; lesson avoids dynamic quota figures.

observations.openai: retry guidance treats Retry-After as the minimum wait and recommends jitter
observations.anthropic: 429 retry behavior depends on error; spend-cap responses can omit retry-after

limitations: Documentation review is not a live SDK or provider request
Provider behavior and SDK defaults can change; verify the chosen endpoint and SDK version
